title: Three Days
notes: Outline, stage 2: "The stage ends after you've run your structure on any three days. They don't have to be in a row." Earns Show the record (outline: earned after any three days of structure). Claude's draft.

effects.objective: Three days of structure, on the record.
Monday's line survived Tuesday. And then some.

text: Three days of structure are on the record now. Not in a row. Not perfect. Three.
Nothing about tonight feels different. That's fine. The record doesn't need you to feel it.
